test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

i. D is between G and A, and is facing B.

ii. F is between A and H, and H is third to the right of D.

iii. E is second to the left of G.

Who are the persons sitting immediately to the left of C?
solution:
Given, from** **i

i. D is between G and A, and is facing B.

There can be two possibilities.

**Case 1:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86476d229513599cc38355679c12804d82aea7e8f8d1a7cef3de0b880e05a0e6.png] 

**Case 2:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67ee3e9a3ca05bd96819bde3964a6ddc63f1af909cfd3b38ecb547a9786d3be5.png] 

ii. F is between A and H, and H is third to the right of D.

**Case 1:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30b17d61b2261390ead8a91dcee9dfe597e85a86354644bea1abf2a98a10d2f4.png] 

This diagram is not satisfying the statement (ii) because in this H is left to D.

That's why Case 1 gets eliminated.

**Case 2:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95f3167d3951a9ac5a29c8cd10709d82a9033dc615feba6d24d420632a5c79a6.png] 

This diagram satisfy the Statement (ii), here H is third to the right of D.

iii. E is second to the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa50d5cdfe87b80f0ee054308124ffe44fbace8caccbb9a72553d28e309855b5.png] 

After drawing all the statement, the final diagram will be drawn like this;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d943511fcdf56059f834edd4d3df6458549b8e95961a60e35b7e12af5c14765f.png] 

**EBH **is sitting immediately to the left of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "EBH".
